title: Lifted Payments Payment Statement Audit Model
subtitle: A processor-neutral merchant statement-audit model with reproducible validation
description: Version 1.1.5 of the Lifted Payments processor-neutral model for normalizing merchant payment-processing statement totals. Kaggle expands the immutable release archive for browsing; the published gate verifies every expanded path and byte against the canonical archive and verifies the SHA-256 sidecar exactly. Canonical methodology: https://liftedpayments.com/payment-processing-statement-audit/ . Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21765625 . Versioned source: https://github.com/Lifted-Holdings/payment-processing-resources/releases/tag/v1.1.5 . Release archive SHA-256: {{RELEASE_ARCHIVE_SHA256}} . The package contains only synthetic data and no real merchant or cardholder data.
